title: Ease of Washing and Drying
text: Ease of Washing and Drying. This cover came exactly as shown.  It is very pretty and washed easily and dried perfectly with no problems and is wrinkle free.  My only problem was that my down blanket did not stay in the cover corners.  I will try it again with another heavier down blanket, but living in New York at this time of year, it will have to wait until the weather turns warmer.

product_metadata.title: Bedsure Duvet Cover Twin Size - Reversible Polka Dot Duvet Cover Set with Zipper Closure, Pink Bedding Set, 2 Pieces, 1 Duvet Cover 68"x90" with 8 Corner Ties and 1 Pillow Sham 20"x26"
features: Fashionable Design: Featuring various design patterns in assorted shades of color tones to convey a spring vibe, this bedding set makes the perfect gift option for different occasions, and can be easily coordinated with most home styles.
Premium Quality: This durable and breathable Bedsure duvet cover is Standard 100 by OEKO-TEX certified for safety, and can withstand washes after washes without color fades and seam slippage.
Extra Comfortable: Brushed over 12 times in the manufacturing process, this vintage comforter cover set is extra delicate, soft on the skin, and free of creaky sounds.
Thoughtful Details: This quilt cover comes with eight ties at each of the edges and corners to help prevent your duvet insert from bunching up inside or shifting, giving you peace of mind in bed.
Easy to Care: This duvet cover set is easy to clean. Simply machine wash cold, and tumble dry low, do not bleach.
What's Inside: This duvet cover set includes a Twin duvet cover (68" x 90") and a pillow sham (20" x 26"). Comforter/duvet insert sold separately.
